Question: Elmer the emu takes \(44\) equal strides to walk between consecutive telephone poles on a rural road. Oscar the ostrich can cover the same distance in \(12\) equal leaps. The telephone poles are evenly spaced, and the \(41\)st pole along this road is exactly one mile (\(5280\) feet) from the first pole. How much longer, in feet, is Oscar’s leap than Elmer’s stride?
